crossRefs.note: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
and if children, then heirs: heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also…
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children…
You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning…
and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease…
Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was…
If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God, and this is the spirit of…
You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the…
We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of…
We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t…
We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother…
Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

translations.web: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
translations.bsb: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
translations.kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
translations.asv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
